sources.purpose: Candidate fire-radiative-power-derived emissions and plume injection metadata.
sources.known_limitations: Product documentation is not acquired fire emissions data; verify species, units, temporal profiles, coverage, access terms, and uncertainty.

sources.purpose: Candidate historical global atmospheric-composition reanalysis; modeled, not monitor data.
sources.known_limitations: Modeled reanalysis is not direct monitoring or fire-attributed exposure; verify variables, units, grid, time coverage, validation, and access.

sources.purpose: Candidate historical weather fields for reviewed transport-model inputs.
sources.known_limitations: Documentation does not provide a configured transport model; verify required fields, units, grid, timestamps, domain, and retrieval requirements.

sources.purpose: Official WorldPop catalogue endpoint; inspect available gridded product aliases and years.
sources.known_limitations: Catalogue discovery is not population-grid acquisition; verify product, year, population strata, resolution, licensing, and geographic coverage.

sources.purpose: Candidate Global Human Settlement Layer population-grid documentation and downloads.
sources.known_limitations: Documentation/download links do not establish a compatible downloaded grid; verify reference year, strata, resolution, licensing, and coverage.

sources.category: Malaysia health, labour, population and prices
sources.purpose: Official API documentation for discovering Malaysia government statistics datasets.
sources.known_limitations: API documentation is not a specific outcome dataset; verify dataset definitions, schemas, units, licensing, and supported query limits.

sources.purpose: Browse official catalogue listings for health, deaths, pollution, labour and price datasets.
sources.known_limitations: Catalogue listings are discovery leads; individual dataset definitions and data must be checked separately.

sources.purpose: Official annual all-cause deaths and crude death rates by residence district and sex; not cause-specific or haze-attributable.
sources.known_limitations: Annual all-cause district counts/rates do not provide cause-specific haze outcomes, event-period rates, age strata, or a risk function.

sources.purpose: Bounded three-row public API sample for aggregated annual all-cause district death counts and rates.
sources.known_limitations: Three rows are only a schema/sample check; all-cause annual data are not a cause-specific event baseline or haze-attributable outcome.

sources.purpose: Official annual public-sector healthcare staff counts by state and type; capacity context, not health outcomes or unit costs.
sources.known_limitations: Staff counts describe service capacity, not health outcomes, treatment utilization, or cost per case.

sources.purpose: Bounded three-row public API sample for aggregated healthcare workforce counts.
sources.known_limitations: Three rows do not establish full coverage; capacity counts are not health outcomes or treatment costs, and field names need schema validation.

sources.purpose: Bounded public API sample of monthly monitoring-station pollutant aggregates for comparison, not a gridded exposure product.
sources.known_limitations: Small monthly station aggregates do not provide event-hour/day gridded population exposure or source attribution; verify pollutant and units.

sources.purpose: Bounded sample of the three latest monthly PM2.5 values for comparison; not a gridded exposure product.
sources.known_limitations: Three monthly values are a smoke-test sample only; they are not a complete time series, gridded exposure, or fire-attributed PM2.5.

sources.purpose: Official monthly national/state Labour Force Survey indicators; not event-related absence or lost workdays.
sources.known_limitations: General labour-market indicators do not measure haze-attributable absence, lost hours, or productivity.

sources.purpose: Bounded three-row API sample of monthly labour-market aggregates.
sources.known_limitations: Three rows are not event-specific worker absence or lost productivity and do not establish complete temporal/geographic coverage.

sources.purpose: Official annual real mean/median monthly wages by state at 2010 prices; wage context, not measured haze-related work loss.
sources.known_limitations: State wage context may support valuation only with an approved method; it is not haze-attributable lost work and requires price-year compatibility.

sources.purpose: Bounded three-row API sample of annual state wage statistics.
sources.known_limitations: Three rows do not establish full coverage or event-related work loss; validate field names, currency/price basis, and target-worker applicability.

sources.purpose: Official annual public-sector active hospital bed counts; service capacity, not health outcomes or treatment unit costs.
sources.known_limitations: Bed counts describe public-sector capacity, not haze-related admissions, resource use, or treatment cost.

sources.purpose: Bounded three-row API sample of annual public hospital bed counts.
sources.known_limitations: Three rows are only a sample; bed counts do not measure haze-related outcomes, utilization, or treatment costs.

sources.purpose: Official OpenDOSM API documentation linked from the Data.gov.my API guide.
sources.known_limitations: Documentation is not a downloaded dataset; verify each dataset's schema, units, coverage, terms, and endpoint separately.

sources.purpose: Official DOSM open-data portal; discover documented datasets and download/API links.
sources.known_limitations: Portal discovery does not establish that candidate tables contain event-specific model inputs; validate each dataset independently.

sources.purpose: District-level population candidate; not a population grid.
sources.known_limitations: Administrative district totals are not a population raster; grid allocation and population strata would require separate data/methods.

sources.purpose: Official monthly air-pollution dataset candidate; verify variables and monitoring basis.
sources.known_limitations: Monthly monitoring data are not necessarily event-resolution gridded exposure; verify pollutant definitions, station coverage, and units.

sources.purpose: Official labour-market context; not by itself a haze-attributable work-disruption dataset.
sources.known_limitations: Labour-market dashboard indicators do not directly measure event-related absence, lost workdays, or reduced productivity.

sources.purpose: Official producer-price context; not a source of health-outcome unit costs.
sources.known_limitations: Producer-price indices may support price adjustment only where methodologically appropriate; they are not treatment costs or welfare values.

sources.purpose: Health evidence and guideline reference; not a Malaysia-specific risk-function approval.
sources.known_limitations: Guidelines are not necessarily a quantitative concentration-response function and do not establish Malaysia-specific applicability.

sources.purpose: Official documentation for the WHO Global Health Observatory OData API.
sources.known_limitations: API documentation does not identify a suitable local cause-specific event baseline; verify indicators, definitions, dimensions, and returned coverage.

sources.purpose: WHO Global Health Estimates theme page for mortality indicators and technical sources.
sources.known_limitations: Country-level estimates may not match local causes, strata, geography, event period, or official national statistics.

sources.purpose: WHO metadata for age-standardized NCD mortality rates; broad baseline context, not haze-attributable outcomes.
sources.known_limitations: Age-standardized broad NCD rates are not event-specific attributable outcomes; check outcome definition, strata, geography, and time coverage.

sources.purpose: Bounded official GHO indicator catalogue query to identify API codes for the documented NCD mortality indicator.
sources.known_limitations: Indicator lookup is metadata discovery, not a validated local outcome series or complete baseline data.

sources.purpose: Bounded Malaysia-filtered example using the WHO-documented API pattern; life expectancy is not a cause-specific haze input.
sources.known_limitations: Life-expectancy sample does not provide cause-specific haze baseline rates; bounded response and country-level scope limit use.

sources.purpose: Method/software reference for health-impact analysis; US functions are not automatically transferable to Malaysia.
sources.known_limitations: US documentation or risk functions do not establish methodological approval or population applicability in Malaysia.
